headings.strategy: Geometric and clean, providing an Apple/Linear aesthetic. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers.

body.strategy: Highly legible, geometric sans-serif for optimal readability in tools.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: 16px (rounded-2xl) for main containers, rounded-full for pills/primary buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, Apple-inspired elevations. light mode: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]. dark mode: use 1px borders with inner glow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, floating navs. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60. MUST have a delicate 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) over backgrounds to remove digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Vercel/Linear inspired directory layout. Generous padding.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Massive typography, central search bar, abstract background imagery. High negative space.
grids_and_layouts.tools_grid: Bento or uniform card grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4. gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.tool_page: Split layout: Tool interface in main central column (col-span-8), sidebar or details on right (col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Google Material spacing (generous). Use py-20 or py-24 for main sections. p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

components.buttons: Animated hover states (scale-95), rounded-xl, high contrast. Primary uses #2563EB.
components.cards: Soft hover lift (-translate-y-1), 16px radius, subtle border.
components.inputs: Rounded-xl, large click targets (h-12 or h-14 for main search). Focus states with 2px ring.
components.navigation: Sticky glass header, global search shortcut (Cmd+K).

patterns.hover: Scale down slightly on click (0.97), lift on hover for cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary blue #2563EB has accessible text over it (white text).
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none on all interactives.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons. data-testid on all key elements.

images.description: Blurry flower/abstract shape in blue and pink
Elegant portrait of a young male professional

media.icons: lucide-react for all general UI icons. Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) if additional premium weight is needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build this app using Tailwind CSS and raw HTML tags for layout structures to ensure maximum flexibility.
Use Shadcn primitives (Dialog, Select, Dropdown, Accordion) ONLY for complex interactive components.
Strictly adhere to the dark/light mode setup. Implement a global theme toggle.
DO NOT make generic centered layouts. Use F-pattern for dashboards and tools directory.
The Hero search bar must be large, centered, with glassmorphism or a subtle glow (Linear inspired).
Each tool card must have a subtle hover effect (e.g., `-translate-y-1` and a refined box-shadow).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. They must be solid or blurred with high opacity.
Use Framer Motion to animate tool grids in the homepage and to transition between states in individual tools.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never apply universal transition like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center }).
No generic, AI-slop outputs. Use tight letter spacing for headings, and generous padding for sections.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do not use dummy placeholder images. Only use the images provided in the media section.

3d_and_creative_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for this utility app, but a subtle Framer Motion parallax or TS Particles in the hero section would elevate the 'Modern SaaS' vibe.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Design for speed and responsiveness. A utility tool platform is judged on performance.
Keep tool interfaces immediate. The core action (e.g., compress image) should be visible above the fold.
Use progressive disclosure for advanced settings in tools.
Ensure the left sidebar or top navigation is consistently accessible across all pages.
Include clear, SEO-friendly structured content (H1s, FAQs, How-To) below the interactive tool interface.
